place.name: Observation Deck
place.description: You stand beneath a vast glass dome overlooking a swirling nebula. Stars burn silently in every direction. A damaged antenna array flickers nearby.

place.name: Hydroponics Lab
place.description: Alien plants grow in nutrient mist beneath artificial sunlight. The scent of oxygen and damp soil fills the air.

place.name: Docking Ring
place.description: You are inside a rotating docking ring. Through reinforced windows you see distant stars and a nearby moon. Escape pods line the walls.

place.name: Navigation Core
place.description: A spherical chamber filled with holographic star maps. Constellations rotate slowly in midair.

place.name: Cargo Hold
place.description: Massive containers drift in a cavernous bay. A cracked crate reveals strange alien artifacts.

place.name: Plasma Conduit
place.description: A narrow maintenance corridor crackles with exposed plasma streams contained behind flickering energy shields.

place.name: Airlock Exterior
place.description: You cling to the outer hull of the station. Below you stretches an endless void scattered with distant galaxies.

place.name: Reactor Core
place.description: A towering fusion reactor pulses with brilliant light. Energy surges through massive conduits.

place.name: Maintenance Shaft
place.description: A cramped vertical shaft lined with cables and blinking relays. The hum of machinery vibrates through the metal walls.

place.name: Cryo Chamber
place.description: Rows of cryogenic pods glow faint blue. Frost clings to the floor panels. One pod stands open.

place.name: Quantum Hall
place.description: A long corridor where the walls shimmer like liquid glass. Time feels unstable here.

place.name: Asteroid Chasm
place.description: You drift inside a fractured asteroid tunnel lit by glowing mineral veins. Loose debris floats lazily in zero gravity.

place.name: Engineering Bay
place.description: Tools float freely in microgravity. A diagnostic console flashes a warning: "WARP MATRIX UNSTABLE."

place.name: Quantum Nexus
place.description: You enter a chamber of shifting light and distorted space-time. Reality bends inward toward a radiant singularity.
